kjv: [when] the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about (KJV 49:5)
mine: when the iniquity of those who cheat me surrounds me
note: 'aqevay is best read 'oqevay "my supplanters/deceivers" ('aqav "cheat", cf. Jacob), matching v.7 "those who trust in their wealth"; "my heels" is the literal vocalisation.

kjv: Their (the fools') inward thought [is, that] their houses [shall continue] for ever (KJV 49:11)
mine: Their (the fools') graves are their homes forever
note: MT qirbam "their inward part"; I follow LXX, Syriac and Targum reading qivram "their grave" (transposed letters); the KJV keeps MT and supplies four italic words.

kjv: death shall feed on them (the fools) (KJV 49:14)
mine: death shall be their (the fools') shepherd
note: mawet yir'em "death shepherds them" continues the sheep image; ra'ah is "to shepherd, pasture", not "to feed on".
